title: AIOS memory is local-first with Graphiti outbox
text: Use a local-first AIOS memory layer with JSONL events, facts, decisions, Markdown summaries, and a Graphiti-ready outbox before relying on external memory services.
decision: Use a local-first AIOS memory layer with JSONL events, facts, decisions, Markdown summaries, and a Graphiti-ready outbox before relying on external memory services.
rationale: The AIOS already uses file-based memory and must remain usable across Codex, Claude, Gemini, Jarvis, and local scripts even when Graphiti or external services are offline.
